skills.name: Context Hygiene
skills.description: Audit and prune stale planning artifacts, session handovers, and debug traces. Fails-closed on active specs/handovers.

modes.audit: Scan and report candidates without deleting
modes.prune: Archive completed artifacts, delete regenerable debug files

skills.name: MemPalace Management
skills.description: Wake-up, checkpoint, and handover memory loop using MemPalace with local handover/state authority.

modes.wake-up: Read MemPalace context first, then confirm local state index + latest handover
modes.checkpoint: Update handover draft and mine memory artifacts after each micro-task
modes.handover: Finalize handover JSON, update state index, and refresh MemPalace index

skills.name: Resource & Docker Management
skills.description: Guides for analyzing resource consumption (Chromium multi-process, memory constraints) and deploying changes safely to the running Docker environment.

modes.audit: Diagnose multi-process tree structure, active Chromium/Playwright usage, and V8 heap constraints vs. physical RAM limits.
modes.deploy: Build and restart the docker-compose service safely, preserving named volumes and environment overrides.

skills.name: UI Schema Governance
skills.description: Validate UI schema contracts (*.ui-schema.yaml), audit field drift against DB schema (NOT NULL / enum alignment), and distill compact prompt DSL for LLMs using @tools/ui-schema-engine.

modes.validate: Check syntax of *.ui-schema.yaml contracts against ui-schema.v1.schema.json
modes.audit: Audit UI field contracts against DB schema for required-not-null and enum-options-match drift
modes.prompt: Distill UI contract into ultra-compact prompt DSL block (<180 tokens/view) for LLM generation
modes.extract: Extract UI schema contracts from running app via headless Playwright aria crawler

skills.name: Refactor Engine
skills.description: Audit codebase limits (file/function length), scan AST-grep/regex anti-patterns, maintain technical debt baselines, and execute automated class/module splits behind facades.

modes.audit: Scan files or staged diffs for line length and anti-pattern breaches
modes.baseline: Lower or raise technical debt grandfathering baseline
modes.split: Plan, apply, and verify byte-for-byte class or module extractions

safety.write_lowers_only: baseline --write only lowers counts; raises require explicit reason

skills.name: Architecture Governance
skills.description: FINOS CALM architecture-as-code model validation, network topology rule enforcement, egress host checking, and visual docify generation.

modes.validate: Strict CALM model validation against forbidden connections and undeclared egress
modes.diff: Compare candidate CALM model against baseline model
modes.docify: Build rendered architecture diagrams and markdown documentation

skills.name: Ad Template Engine
skills.description: Compiler engine for building static ad template HTML from YAML schema data.

modes.generate: Compile ad-data.yaml into static HTML layout
modes.extract: Extract ad fields from HTML template into ad-data.yaml
